description: "A Terrible Secret: A Novel" by May Agnes Fleming is a work of fiction that appears to have been written in the late 19th century. The story follows the tumultuous and emotionally charged life of Inez Catheron, who is on the brink of marriage to the handsome Sir Victor Catheron.
